title: Affine section tomography for inverse source problems in $k$-Hessian equations with restricted large boundary data
summary: We consider an inverse source problem for the $k$-Hessian equation \begin{equation*} σ_k(D^2u)=f(x) \end{equation*} on the $k$-admissible branch in a smooth uniformly convex domain in $\mathbb R^n$, where $2\le k\le n$. We prove that the nonlinear Dirichlet-to-Neumann map determines the positive smooth source from its values on the restricted large-data rays $tφ_E|_{\partialΩ}$, where $E\in Gr(k-1,n)$, $φ_E(x)=|P_Ex|^2/2$, and $t$ is sufficiently large.
